---
title: "regions"
subtitle: "Categorical layers (regions, zones, basins, ...) and masks derived from them"
---

## Overview

`regions` holds named **layers** on a grid: 2D integer fields with a table
of names of their codes, such as regions, zones or basins. Logical masks are
derived from them with short selection expressions. The module knows nothing
about the content of a layer beyond what it is told:

- **Any file**: an integer variable of any file (`regions_load_layer`,
  namelist key `layers`). The names of its codes are given (`codes`,
  `names`), else read from the CF attributes `flag_values` and
  `flag_meanings`, else the codes themselves.
- **The program**: a field already in memory (`regions_add_layer`).
- **[FesmData](https://github.com/fesmc/FesmData) v2** files, which every
  domain grid folder `$ICE_DATA/v2/<Domain>/<GRID>/` holds:

| File | Layers |
|---|---|
| `<GRID>_REGIONS.nc` | `region` (hierarchical; values of `region_3`, names of `region_1..3`), `zone` |
| `<GRID>_BASINS-<set>.nc` | `<set>` (`basin`), `<set>.group` (`basin_group`), `<set>.mask` (`basin_mask`) |

Negative values (e.g. fill values) are `regions_undefined = -1`, as are
cells without a source value after remapping.

**Hierarchical layers** (`region`) have codes of two decimal digits per level
below the first: the path `1.3.1` (Canadian Arctic Archipelago) is the code
`10301`, `1.3` (Greenland) is `103`. A cell holds the code of its deepest
region, so `region:Greenland` selects Greenland with all its subregions.
Codes of FesmData ocean regions start at 51. Any layer may be hierarchical
(`hier`, or the attribute `hierarchical = 1` of its variable).

**FesmData zones**: 0 open ocean, 1 shelf-break buffer, 2 continental shelf,
3 land.

**Grids**: with a target grid (`regions_init(reg, grid)`, or `grid` of
`regions_init_nml`), a file whose grid has another name is remapped onto it
by nearest neighbour. The grid of a file is its global attribute
`grid_name`, else given (`grid_name`, namelist `grid_<layer>`); its cdo
description `grid_<name>.txt` is read next to the file, else from `maps/`,
and the map is cached in `maps/`. A file without a grid name must be on the
target grid. Without a target grid, all layers must have the size of the
first one.

FesmData v1 regions files (one variable `mask`) are rejected by
`regions_load_fesmdata`.

## Selection expressions

| Term | Selects |
|---|---|
| `region:Greenland,1.5,10203` | a hierarchical layer by name, path or code, at any level, with the subregions |
| `zone:land,continental_shelf` | a layer by names or codes |
| `Zwally2012:11,12` | basins of a basin set |
| `Zwally2012.group:1`, `Zwally2012.mask:1` | basin groups, original extent of the basins |
| `all`, `none` | every cell, no cell |

A comma within a term is an OR. A term prefixed by `~` is negated, `&` joins
terms (AND) and `|` joins clauses (OR, binding weaker than `&`); there are no
parentheses. Layers and names are matched ignoring case, with spaces in
names read as underscores (`region:North America`). A name may have several
codes (`Africa` lies in both hemispheres); all are selected. An unknown
layer or a name not on the grid is an error that lists the available ones.

```
region:Greenland & ~zone:open_ocean | Zwally2012:11
```

`!` cannot be used for negation, since the namelist reader takes it as the
start of a comment.

## Derived types

### `regions_class`

| Component | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `nx`, `ny` | `integer` | Size of the layers (the target grid) |
| `with_grid`, `grid` | `logical`, `grid_class` | The target grid |
| `layers(:)` | `region_layer_class` | `name`, `hier`, `values(:,:)`, `tab` (`codes(:)`, `names(:)`) |
| `masks(:)` | `region_mask_class` | Named masks: `name`, `expr`, `mask(:,:)` |

## Public API

| Procedure | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `regions_init(reg, grid, nx, ny)` | An empty set on `grid` (or of size `nx`, `ny`) |
| `regions_init_nml(reg, filename, group, domain, grid_name, subs, grid, verbose)` | Load from a namelist group |
| `regions_load_layer(reg, name, path, var, hier, codes, names, grid_name)` | A layer of any file |
| `regions_load_fesmdata(reg, path)` | Layers `region` and `zone` of a FesmData regions file |
| `regions_load_basins(reg, set, path)` | Layers of a FesmData basins file |
| `regions_add_layer(reg, name, field, codes, names, hier)` | A layer of the program |
| `regions_add_mask(reg, name, expr)` | A named mask |
| `regions_write(reg, filename, grid, layers)` | Write layers with their tables (new file on `grid`, else into `filename`); they load again as they are |
| `regions_find(reg, name)` | Index of a layer (0: none) |
| `regions_select(reg, expr)` | `logical(nx,ny)` of an expression |
| `regions_mask(reg, name)` | `logical(nx,ny)` of a named mask |
| `regions_basin_ids(reg, spec, extent)` | `integer(nx,ny)` ids of a layer (negative as 0); `"None"`: 0 everywhere, `"domain"`: 1 everywhere. `extent`: the layer `<set>.mask`, else ids > 0 |
| `regions_end(reg)` | Deallocate |
| `flag_codes(tab, name)`, `flag_name(tab, code)` | Look-up of names and codes |
| `region_code(path)`, `region_path(code)` | `"1.3.1"` ↔ `10301` |
| `region_level(code)`, `region_ancestor(code, level)`, `in_region(codes, code)` | Code arithmetic (elemental), as in FesmUtils.jl |

Names of layers may not contain `.` (kept for the layers of basin sets) nor
be `regions`, `basins`, `all` or `none`.

## Namelist configuration

All keys are optional; without any, the set is empty.

```
&regions
    ! FesmData
    path_regions   = "ice_data/v2/{domain}/{grid_name}/{grid_name}_REGIONS.nc"
    path_basins    = "ice_data/v2/{domain}/{grid_name}/{grid_name}_BASINS-{set}.nc"
    basin_sets     = "Zwally2012" "Mouginot2019"

    ! Any file
    layers         = "ismip7" "glaciers"
    path_ismip7    = "ice_data/ISMIP7/{domain}/{grid_name}/obs/{grid_name}_ObsISMIP7-v1.3.nc"
    var_ismip7     = "mouginot_basins"      ! default: the layer name
    path_glaciers  = "my_glaciers.nc"
    codes_glaciers = 1 2                    ! default: flag_values, else the codes
    names_glaciers = "Rhone" "Aletsch"      ! default: flag_meanings, else the codes
    hier_glaciers  = False                  ! default: the attribute hierarchical
    grid_glaciers  = "ALPS-1KM"             ! default: the attribute grid_name

    ! Named masks
    masks          = "grl_land" "grl_shelf"
    mask_grl_land  = "region:Greenland & zone:land"
    mask_grl_shelf = "region:Greenland & zone:continental_shelf"
/
```

`{grid_name}` in the paths is `grid_name`; pass the model grid as `grid` to
remap onto it. Extra `{key}` placeholders are filled from `subs`.

## Usage example

```fortran
use regions

type(regions_class) :: reg
logical, allocatable :: mask(:,:)

call regions_init_nml(reg, "par/test.nml", "regions", domain="Greenland", &
                      grid_name="GRL-16KM", grid=grid_model)

mask = regions_mask(reg, "grl_shelf")
mask = regions_select(reg, "Zwally2012.group:1,2 & zone:land")

! A layer of the program, saved with the others
call regions_add_layer(reg, "fast", merge(1, 0, uxy_s > 100.0), codes=[1], names=["fast"])
call regions_write(reg, "regions_GRL-16KM.nc", grid=grid_model)
```
